changes.title: Jungle areas
items: The snake's Norway is now a jungle understory: mossy ironwoods, vinewoods and bamboo among limes and hazels, ferns and flowering shrubs in the leaf litter
The bat's cave mouth is now a jungle cave: old strangler figs, kapoks and yews over the rock walls, ferns between the stalagmites

changes.title: House items
items: The treehouse's furniture is bigger, stands freely and sits by each room's edge, clear of the doorways and facing you
She's a messy witch: shoes round the shoe rack, books by the bestiary, charts by the map table, shavings by the lathe and more on the floors
Her bed stands in the corridor up to the Turret, by the telescope's way up, where she wakes; her clothes from last night wait by the wardrobe in her bedroom
The Studio's synth is a big modular wall of knobs, lights and tangled cables with a keyboard in front

changes.title: Pause pending press
items: A button pressed just as you pause no longer closes the menu you're in
